name: Look at the Size of It!
summary: You have come into a gigantic, ornate pillow that once belonged to Chambermaid Pillaclencher. Evonice Sootsmoker, in the Searing Gorge, is bound to want it.

sections.title: A Pillow for Evonice
sections.body: The pillow Chambermaid Pillaclencher kept is now yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will surely be eager to get hold of it. Bring it to her in the Searing Gorge and see what she offers you for the trouble.

aliases: who do i bring the pillow to
faq.answer: Evonice Sootsmoker, in the Searing Gorge, expected to want it badly.

faq.q: Where does this pillow come from?
faq.answer: It belonged to Chambermaid Pillaclencher, and is gigantic and ornate.

faq.q: Where can Evonice Sootsmoker be found?
